extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 1104db6f6f5db648d30355ff2d845a372f8e37a2e66cb9513e6ede2f863a482d before extraction.

The requested exact identity is LH8050QLT1G, the Q rank listed in the p. 1 ordering table with device marking KEY. The datasheet title is the shared LH8050PLT1G series title; the p. 2 Q classification note gives hFE = 160-320 at the 100 mA test row.
Page 1 lists the device as an NPN silicon transistor. The p. 1 pinout is base, emitter, collector for the SOT-23 package, but pinout is not represented in this schema.

Page 2 states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. Page 3 explicitly plots typical traces at TA = 25 degC, 100 degC, and -25 degC; all plotted traces retained here are approximate manual digitizations of visible grid-aligned observations, with no interpolation between plotted observations.

The p. 2 hFE table publishes a Q-specific range of 160-320 at IC = 100 mA and VCE = 1 V, plus a minimum hFE of 40 at IC = 800 mA and VCE = 1 V. No typical table value was substituted for these guaranteed bounds.

The p. 2 saturation table publishes one maximum VCE(sat) row at IC = 800 mA and IB = 80 mA. No second saturation pair is published, and no VBE(sat) value is published, so vbe_sat is null and no additional table point was invented.

The supplied datasheet has no numeric fT, Cobo, or Cibo row. Those fields are null rather than populated from unrelated plot estimates. The curves page also does not provide a numeric Early-voltage value.

Additional exact evidence not represented by this schema includes maximum ratings VCEO = 50 V, VCBO = 50 V, VEBO = 6 V, IC = 1.5 A, PD = 225 mW, and junction/storage temperature range -55 to +150 degC, all from p. 1.
extraction.omission_reason: No fT, Cobo, Cibo, VBE(sat), or second saturation pair is numerically published in the supplied datasheet. Early voltage and other absolute-rating fields beyond VCEO are not represented by this schema.
